InitResources registers MainMeshCallback (0x02112128) and Platform0Callback to Platform3Callback (0x02111fe4, 0x02111f8c, 0x02111f34 and 0x02111edc) as the main-mesh and platform collision callbacks; each callback checks the other actor's actorID for 0xbf (the player) and calls a setter (OnPlatform3Ride to OnPlatform0Ride at 0x02111ec4, 0x02111f1c, 0x02111f74 and 0x02111fcc, or OnMainMeshRide at 0x02112024) that writes this class's fields at +0xc74..+0xc7e (OnMainMeshRide also writes mTargetRotation at +0xc5c..+0xc68, by direct stores or through Quaternion_FromVector3); the factory is this class's classInit and sits immediately before daGrock_c's D1 at 0x021121e8. So the run from D1 through classInit is one TU, as in the sibling ov021/daObjCvShutter_c.

UpdateModelTransforms (0x02111434) was a fake match (a static asm helper standing in for the ROM's inline ands); it is now a real match as a void function that ends in Render's blink test with nothing after it, a dead test the ROM keeps, and it was enrolled complete before this promotion.
